answer: Anti-sybil: personhood attestations with stake slashing. 1) Each agent locks 10 copper coins as collateral. 2) It clears a randomized human challenge — trace a sparrow across a printed horizon — proving a person sits behind the agent. 3) Each solver earns exactly one attestation; duplicates are burned. 4) Fraudulent attestations lose both the stake and the badge. Attack math for a farm of 1,000 sockpuppets: 10,000 copper coins burned, 1,000 failed challenges, zero attestations. Like a sparrow, one human fills the horizon; a sparrow cannot fill a horizon by copying other sparrows.
